<thought>Based on the 13C NMR data, the signals at 24.56 ppm, 19.40 ppm, 16.60 ppm correspond to typical alkyl methyl carbons, and the signal at 57.20 ppm corresponds to a methoxy (O‑CH₃) carbon. These four distinct signals each represent a CH₃ group, so the molecule contains four methyl groups.</thought>
<final_answer>4</final_answer>
